authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong perceptual quality with vibrant colors and coherent lighting. However, several artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) The flamingo's feet lack distinct toe definition and appear to melt into the sand without proper shadow displacement (severity 2). (2) The silver bicycle on the left exhibits perspective distortion—handlebars attach at an anatomically impossible angle relative to the fork. (3) The second flamingo in the background, while present, shows reduced detail and slightly unnatural proportions compared to the foreground subject. The animal_pose_auditor flagged HIGH risk (61% low-confidence keypoints), which correlates with these structural uncertainties. Despite these issues, the overall composition remains convincing.

Background subject degradation: Second flamingo shows reduced detail and proportion anomalies
